name: popsicle
headline: SoundCloud Play Generator Bot - Automate Track
short_description: SoundCloud play generator bot increases track plays for musicians and marketers. Automates play generation to boost track visibility. Connects to SoundCloud API for direct integration.
author: somiibo

sections.overview:
SoundCloud Play Generator Bot is free software that generates plays on SoundCloud tracks through automated methods. It features a proxy scraper that retrieves fresh proxies every 24 hours, allowing users to target specific countries while randomizing user agents and HTTP referrers to avoid detection. The tool works across Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms via command-line installation. Musicians and marketers use it to increase track visibility and play counts without manual intervention. The bot provides customizable settings for user agents, referrers, and geographic targeting.
Boost play counts on new SoundCloud releases
Increase track visibility for independent musicians
Test SoundCloud tracks across multiple geographic regions
Automate promotional play generation for marketing campaigns
